posts.author: p-ravi-menon
posts.body: Has anyone been able to use Anthropic's Claude models from Copilot Studio? I can see the model choice in Microsoft's documentation but not in our environment. Is it an admin setting, a licence question, or simply not approved yet?

replies.author: p-daniel-price
replies.body: Model choice is switched on per environment by the platform admins, so it will not show up until they enable it.

replies.author: p-mei-lin
replies.body: Raise it as an AI Request so the model is reviewed before anyone switches it on. Reviewed requests are what the admins act on.

replies.author: p-ravi-menon
replies.body: Thanks both. Submitting the request now.

posts.author: p-ana-ortega
posts.title: Pluralsight and Microsoft Learn now sit side by side in Learning
posts.body: You can browse both catalogs in the AI Hub, open any course's details without leaving the page, and read Microsoft Learn modules right here. Pluralsight videos still play on Pluralsight's own site.

replies.author: p-grace-kim
replies.body: The role-based recommendations now draw on both catalogs, so check For You again.

replies.author: p-tom-becker
replies.body: Reading the Learn units in the hub is a real time saver. No more twenty open tabs.

posts.author: p-tom-becker
posts.title: What Operations learned from three AI pilots
posts.body: This quarter we piloted three uses: drafting call summaries, triaging inbound documents, and checking forms for missing fields. The biggest lesson was to agree the human review step before the pilot starts, not after. Happy to share the checklist we used.

replies.author: p-omar-haddad
replies.body: Please do share the checklist. We are about to start a pilot in Risk.

replies.author: p-tom-becker
replies.body: Sent it to you directly. Anyone else who wants it, reply here.

posts.author: p-samuel-adeyemi
posts.title: A prompt pattern that cut my rework
posts.body: Give the model the output format first, then the source text, then the task. My summaries stopped drifting between runs. Has anyone found a better order?

replies.author: p-grace-kim
replies.body: Same here. Adding one short example of the output helps even more.

replies.author: p-tom-becker
replies.body: I also ask it to list what it could not find in the source. It flags gaps instead of filling them.

replies.author: p-samuel-adeyemi
replies.body: Good one. Adding that to my template.

posts.author: p-samuel-adeyemi
posts.body: What is everyone's workflow for preparing a client review pack? I use Copilot to draft the agenda but still pull the numbers together by hand.

replies.author: p-ana-ortega
replies.body: Check Discover for agents tagged for relationship managers. A few of them assemble the standard sections for you.

posts.author: p-priya-nair
posts.body: Before I try it: may I paste a client email into Copilot Chat if I remove the client's name first?

replies.author: p-mei-lin
replies.body: Check the data-handling policy in the Governance pillar first. It decides what may go into which tool, and removing a name is not always enough.

replies.author: p-priya-nair
replies.body: Understood. I will check before pasting anything.

posts.author: p-priya-nair
posts.title: Thank you to the KYC team
posts.body: Thanks to the KYC team for walking us through the screening agent. The first-pass review on the pilot set was much easier to follow.

replies.author: p-laura-chen
replies.body: Glad it helped. We are running the session again next month.

posts.author: p-omar-haddad
posts.body: New to this. Should I start with a Pluralsight course on generative AI, or with Microsoft Learn's AI fluency modules?

replies.author: p-grace-kim
replies.body: Start with Microsoft Learn's Explore Generative AI. It is short and you can read it inside the hub. Then take a Pluralsight course for depth in your area.

posts.author: p-daniel-price
posts.title: Test agents before you publish them
posts.body: We now run every agent through a set of twenty test questions before publishing, including a few it should refuse. It has caught two topic routing mistakes already.

replies.author: p-ravi-menon
replies.body: The refuse cases are a great idea. Stealing that.

posts.author: p-omar-haddad
posts.body: Where do I ask for access to an agent?

replies.author: p-ana-ortega
replies.body: Open the agent's page in Discover and choose Request access. You can follow the request from your account page.

posts.author: p-grace-kim
posts.title: Prompt of the week: meeting notes to actions
posts.body: Ask for owners, dates and open questions as three separate lists. It keeps the summary honest about what was not decided.

posts.author: p-mei-lin
posts.title: Reminder: no client data in community posts
posts.body: Community posts are visible to everyone in the community. Keep client names, account numbers and any other client data out of posts and replies.
